first_experiments.access_detail: Personal tokens or registered apps; organization approval/SSO may restrict customer resources.

first_experiments.access_detail: Trial API limit explicitly documented at 50 calls/minute.

first_experiments.access_detail: Open-source local CLI; Node/browser runtime required; no account credentials.
first_experiments.surface: CLI; diagrams to SVG, PNG or PDF, not a hosted REST service
first_experiments.note: An agent-callable subprocess tool is sufficient; a native MCP server is not necessary.
